Playbook.name: ACH — Role or User Change Submitted by an Unexpected Maker - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: An ACH role/user change was submitted by a maker not previously seen doing so (new_terms on USERNAME_MAKER). Triage: an unexpected user modifying ACH roles/users (privilege manipulation), or a newly-authorised maker?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Unexpected changes to ACH roles/users can grant fraudulent payment privileges.

LogSources.LogSource: ACH/ECC application audit via apps-* - apps-*

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Banking-app audit in apps-* (verified live). ACH maker-checker fields USERNAME_MAKER/USERNAME_CHECKER; ECC user-admin type ECC_USR_AUDIT. type field distinguishes app streams (ACHAPP, ECC_USR_AUDIT).

Signal.Name: Role or User Change Submitted by an Unex
Signal.Details: ACH role/user change by a first-seen maker.

Input.name: $user
Input.description: The maker who submitted the change (USERNAME_MAKER).

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the new maker's role/user change is unauthorised privilege manipulation or a legitimate new maker.

Step.name: Role/user changes submitted by this maker
Step.Purpose: What role/user changes the new maker submitted, and whether they grant payment privileges, sets the risk.
Step.Query: FROM apps-* | WHERE type == "ACHAPP" AND USERNAME_MAKER == "$user" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, USERNAME_MAKER, USERNAME_CHECKER, type | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: A new maker granting ACH roles/payment privileges, especially self-checked or to suspicious users, is privilege manipulation. A newly-onboarded ACH admin performing expected changes is benign. Correlate the change detail in the app.

Node.Condition: A new maker granting payment/admin privileges, especially with SoD issues.
Node.Result: True Positive (ACH Privilege Manipulation - escalate, fraud/compliance)

Node.Condition: A newly-onboarded, authorised ACH maker performing expected changes.
An operational process using a new maker account (baseline gap).

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-ACHROLE-CHANGE to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm onboarding; baseline; close as false_positive.
Escalate to fraud/compliance; reverse the changes; review the maker; open IR.

Misconfiguration.Definition: An ACH process using an unbaselined maker account.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify the changes; if privilege manipulation, escalate to fraud/compliance.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Escalate to fraud/compliance; reverse changes; review the maker; open IR.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Govern ACH maker onboarding; enforce maker-checker on role changes; alert on new makers.

QualityChecks.Check: new_terms on USERNAME_MAKER; type ACHAPP. Correlate change detail in the app.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Changes reversed; fraud/compliance engaged; maker reviewed.
